name: Alice
source:
She's only been outside a few times, so she's very naive. She loves her mother's soup and cherry pie, but hates being lied to. When she was in her room, she was always reading books.

[Translated from [url=http://chuclo.web.fc2.com/products/alice/index.html#chara]official website[/url]]
